claims.answer: Local agents run on the user Mac, either under Seatbelt or in a local Linux micro-VM. A separately running fletch-host can outlive its remote clients on a machine left on.

evidence.locator: README.md: Quick start, Supported harnesses, What you get, Sandboxing
evidence.finding: Documents the macOS app, six named harnesses, parallel isolated clones, workflow gates, Git/PR controls and free AGPL use.

evidence.title: Fletch: LICENSE
evidence.locator: LICENSE: GNU Affero General Public License Version 3, title and terms

evidence.title: Fletch: persistent Claude runner
evidence.locator: module contract lines 1-12; ManagedSession::spawn command construction lines 89-94
evidence.finding: The pinned persistent runner launches the Claude coding CLI with --print, stream-json input/output and the stdio permission protocol, then spawns the specified command in the session working directory. The separate claude.rs adapter documents --session-id/--resume transcript integration.

evidence.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/codex.rs
evidence.finding: Builds the Codex coding CLI exec/resume command with JSON events and session arguments.

evidence.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/cursor.rs
evidence.finding: Builds the Cursor Agent CLI print command with stream-json, force/trust and optional resume arguments.

evidence.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/opencode.rs
evidence.finding: Builds the OpenCode CLI run command with JSON output and session arguments.

evidence.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/pi.rs
evidence.finding: Builds the Pi coding CLI print command with JSON mode and a persistent session path. The dated maintainer discussion marks Pi experimental.

evidence.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/agent/providers/antigravity.rs
evidence.finding: Builds the Antigravity coding CLI print/conversation command. The dated maintainer discussion marks this integration experimental.

evidence.title: Fletch: docs/isolation.md
evidence.locator: The model in one paragraph; engines; engine_for_spawn; retired engine restriction
evidence.finding: Each agent uses a full shared-object clone. Seatbelt confines writes but leaves host reads/network open; the Linux micro-VM has different boundaries. Docker and Podman engines are retired and stamped workspaces refuse to run.

evidence.title: Fletch: src/components/RightPanel/Code/DiffView.tsx
evidence.locator: useFileDiff lines 32-53; DiffBody and DiffLineRow lines 81-160
evidence.finding: The accessible Code/Git panel renderer parses a fetched unified diff and displays hunk headers, old/new line numbers, addition/deletion sigils and highlighted code-line text.

evidence.title: Fletch: crates/fletch-core/src/telemetry.rs
evidence.locator: init, track, set_enabled; configured API key and host; feedback exception
evidence.finding: Configured builds send usage events to PostHog; track honors the persisted flag and the in-app setting updates it. User-submitted feedback uses the same transport but deliberately bypasses that usage flag.

evidence.title: Fletch: src-tauri/src/lib.rs
evidence.finding: Usage analytics is enabled unless the saved flag is false. Sentry crash/error reporting in DSN-configured builds is initialized independently of that flag. The source calls crash reporting app health; this catalog counts diagnostics as ADE telemetry.

evidence.title: Fletch: src/components/SettingsScreen/GeneralPane.tsx
evidence.finding: Settings exposes a Usage analytics toggle. It does not establish a control that stops the independently initialized Sentry crash path.

evidence.title: Fletch: docs/cloud-runner-setup.md
evidence.locator: opening paragraphs and On the runner disk; Creating it
evidence.finding: Current source documentation describes fletch-host running on the user cloud-provider machine without the laptop, with paired devices connecting through the relay. Distribution parity was not checked.

evidence.title: Fletch known gaps
evidence.locator: Discussion #523 body, last updated November 10, 2026, items 1, 4, 7 and 8
evidence.finding: The maintainer explicitly says the desktop is macOS only, usage analytics default on, fletch-host can run on a Mac/Linux machine without a connected laptop, and Pi/Antigravity remain experimental. Quit stops local agents; closing the desktop window only hides it.
